maintenance_led.reason: Revenue mainly from new school buses (Type A, C, D; electric, propane) sold via dealers; parts and service are secondary.

publicly_funded.reason: Main customers are public school districts buying school buses with public funds, plus some private contractors; grants support electric buses.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by selling its own buses; only occasional deals, such as consolidating the Micro Bird joint venture.

mission_critical.reason: Districts buy buses through competitive bids and can switch makers at each purchase, though safety certification and parts familiarity add some friction.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgment call; the buses are safety-regulated, but switching suppliers between purchases is feasible.
